agreements: The scientific and systems interpretations correctly agree on the accepted scientific substance: v2d is an exact six-named-life conditional interface calibration, not evidence of population effects, autonomous learning, memory, discovery, final behavior, architecture superiority, efficiency, transport, replication, publication, or an automatic next experiment.

The shared 514-call prefix, terminal-justified unpadded THINK_0 prefixes, explicit PRIMARY_UNDEFINED outcomes, complete target-blind and q-guided selectors, post-prefix measured-balance timing, same-q_own scoring, common logical randomness with unique physical calls, and exact D-scaled accounting are coherent and must be preserved semantically in any repair.

The alias/redaction boundary, canonical ASCII parser, append-only provisional outputs, scorer-inaccessible phase-A raw seal, comparable visible-input controls, four separate offline closure metrics, phase-B final verification, shortcut-survivor reporting, and unconditional stop at Rohin form an adequate no-online-oracle and claim-limitation contract.

The exact sorted four-atom canonical scope, exact forbidden scope, phased implementation/testing then postcommit-analysis/GPU authority, immutable identical review evidence excluding mutable intake.state.json, independent-review precedence, non-overriding author advocate, and separate supervisor revalidation are accepted governance semantics and confer no authority before a releasable consensus and exact human ratification.

The immutable eight-call zero-science envelope resource, clean pinned model/tokenizer, one >=95000-MiB H100 NVL requirement, disabled cache/truncation, per-call reset/allocation telemetry, unique sessions/receipts, and no-public-science-material rule are accepted reproducibility and pre-science isolation requirements.

All 26 proposed acceptance tests are necessary future gates rather than completed evidence. Passing them would establish contract fidelity only; it would not predict a favorable result or authorize implementation, provider activity, a GPU run, follow-up, or claim promotion.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose, loop text, workflow intent, and future acceptance tests are sufficient to enforce that exploratory ceilings run only for D-defined lives after their branches when the canonical graph gives v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings no inbound edge.

positions.position: The intended order is coherent and the proposal may proceed because the specification and workflow describe 17D exploratory calls only for defined lives after branch execution.

The graph delta is itself a normative architecture artifact. With no edge targeting v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings, the graph permits that node to execute before D, for PRIMARY_UNDEFINED lives, or independently of completion of the 48 branch calls and 3 MEMORY_1 checkpoints, so proceed is blocked.

resolution.rationale: The cross-critique is correct. v2d_exact_four_scope_phase_gate and v2d_concrete_zero_science_envelopes are legitimate graph roots, but the ceilings node is not: its own text says defined-life only, the experiment specification requires it after branches, and phase A counts it as downstream raw cognition. The workflow delegates the internal science schedule to one opaque remote command and therefore does not supply a graph predecessor. A future test can detect a defect but cannot repair the exact proposal bytes that human ratification would bind. The missing edge is thus a real architecture-order defect affecting undefined-life exclusion, D-scaled spend, raw sealing, and final graph completeness.
resolution.selected_position: Accept the blocking critique and require a fresh, hash-bound minimal repair before a new deliberation or ratification path.
resolution.required_change: Create a new proposal-only chg_20260901_v03r_recurrence_closure_dev_v2e package; do not mutate, ratify, initialize, implement, or execute v2d. Preserve every accepted v2d science, visibility, schedule, selector, scorer, claim, forbidden-scope, four-phase-authority, review, durability, and zero-science-envelope requirement semantically. Mechanically update only fresh-version identifiers, paths, scope-atom suffixes, workflow bindings, and dependent hashes as required. Add exactly one explicit precedence edge from the completed raw branch-cognition node to the defined-life exploratory-ceilings node, while retaining ceilings-to-phase-A: its contract must require that a life is in frozen D, all 48 branch RETURN_SLEEP calls and all 3 MEMORY_1 checkpoints for that life have frozen without branch-integrity failure, then and only then exactly one full-context plus sixteen RAG calls may run; PRIMARY_UNDEFINED lives receive zero. Add a static graph regression assertion for that inbound predecessor. Regenerate two fresh-context independent v2e interpretations, adversarial critique, adjudicated consensus, exact workflow/closure hashes, and only afterward a new exact human-ratification path. No prior v2d interpretation, critique, consensus, or prospective ratification may be inherited as approval.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. Direct graph inspection confirms indegree zero for v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings and only the outbound v2d_ceilings_to_phase_a edge. Neither normative prose nor the opaque launch_remote_science workflow command creates the missing after-D/after-branch edge. The defect can permit undefined-life spend or incomplete branch precedence and therefore conflicts with five named acceptance gates plus static graph integrity.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Perform only the fresh v2e edge-and-binding repair specified by the resolution, preserve accepted science and governance semantics, regenerate every dependent deliberation artifact, and keep implementation and provider/GPU activity forbidden.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain its fail-before-sync/provider contract. In the fresh repair its architecture check must explicitly reject a defined-life exploratory node lacking the required completed-branch predecessor; the test cannot cure the currently defective graph bytes.
Its exclusions for final cognition, online truth or normalization, LoRA, transport, pooling, follow-up, claim expansion, and automatic go are sound and unaffected by the edge repair.
The exact synthetic-only H100/provider feasibility and isolation gate is coherent, remains before public inputs, and is independent of the downstream graph-edge defect.
The exact 514 physically shared DREAM calls, six terminal proofs, 0..72 observed THINK calls, no padding, and sunk-artifact preservation are accepted unchanged.

The undefined-life zero-branch/selector/MEMORY_1/scorer/exploratory rule is correct and directly demonstrates why the missing graph predecessor blocks v2d. Preserve the test and make the repaired graph encode the rule.
The fixed same-life public-probe distractor and fail-closed malformed/equal-field behavior prevent adaptive comparator selection and require no change.
The complete target-blind no-feedback ranks, ties, metadata invariance, and sixteen distinct logical rounds are fully specified and unaffected by the repair.
Post-prefix, pre-branch global balance timing, exact formulas, explicit MISSING handling, finite determinism, sunk-call reporting, and non-identification language are accepted unchanged.
The distinction between per-candidate structural opportunity and selected-union mechanical opportunity is necessary for stable eligibility and balance interpretation.
Binding every model and control outcome to identical q_own while limiting q_dist to trusted selection metadata is essential to both allocation contrasts and needs no repair.
Arm-independent logical seeds, unique physical identities, frozen cyclic order, position balance, and replay invariance correctly constrain stochastic and order confounding.
Connector bijection, raw-ID and sentinel exclusion, canonical ASCII/schema limits, exact token caps, and no repair/retry form a sound provider-visibility boundary.
Append-only provisional writes and outcome-invariant later scheduling correctly exclude admission, support, normalization, mutation, retry, and verifier feedback.

The formulas recurrent=514+48D, exploratory=17D, selectors=48D, and MEMORY_1/scorers=3D are correct. The repaired edge must make exploratory=17D causally downstream of completed branches rather than merely numerically reconcilable.
Exact physical/logical/attributed bijections, immutable requests and outcomes, unique sessions/receipts, and seed independence from physical identity remain necessary and sufficient ledger checks.

The scorer-inaccessible raw-graph seal is sound, but it must receive exploratory rows only through the repaired completed-branch-to-ceilings edge; otherwise cardinal completeness does not establish causal order.
Exact visible-input controls with common slot-level units, separate ablations and privileged bounds, identical denominators, and no residual subtraction appropriately expose compiler effects.
Four independent own-target booleans, exact/null allowlist behavior, explicit normalization-only differences, common aggregates, and immutable raw proposals are scientifically well bounded.
Failing private leaks while reporting allowed visible order, endpoint, alias, shared-C, texture, schema-position, and policy-recovery survivors is necessary to qualify any result.

Its exactly-17D, defined-only, heterogeneous-ceiling, non-primary-evidence contract is correct and is the acceptance test most directly violated by the current graph. Preserve it and encode its after-branch prerequisite explicitly in the fresh graph.
Independent scored-graph closure and exactly-one done-or-failed marker are sound, but phase B cannot retroactively repair a raw graph whose exploratory node lacked its required predecessor.

Identical closed reviewer bytes, complete static/dynamic/resource dependencies, immutable ratification binding, separate final intake validation, and exclusion of mutable intake.state.json are accepted governance requirements.
Only infrastructure observation may resume; scientific identities, order, seeds, views, calls, and failures may never regenerate or repeat. The repair does not change this durability rule.

Exact-six-life claim language, no population/general/efficiency/discovery claim, exact authority initialization, and unconditional human termination are accepted and must survive the fresh version mechanically.

Exact sorted requested and forbidden arrays, no overlap or inference, implementation/testing before review, postcommit-only analysis, and reviewed zero-science as first GPU use correctly close the prior authority defect.

Pinned generation, four exact classes, two ordered calls per class, eight byte/token/seed bindings, exact output maxima, telemetry thresholds, and no public science material make feasibility reproducible and fail closed.
